name: Chris Dunn
life: “My friend used to ask for violets when she meant she needed company.” People around the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio know Chris by a small Sunday habit. Chris notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: I borrowed the ring to water geraniums. I should have told the driver the flowers belonged to my late girlfriend.
appearance: Chris is easy to recognize by a smooth side part with one rebellious curl and a softly rounded chin under sharp cheekbones. Usually dressed in an olive canvas jacket with a cloth patch so neatly matched it only shows in strong light, Chris listens with the head tilted a little to the left when listening.
personality: Chris keeps other people's confidences so well that friends sometimes mistake discretion for taking sides. Chris wants to be trusted and resents being asked for proof of it.
agenda: To keep watering a dead friend's geraniums with permission.
family: Damian Mack is Chris’s half-sibling. Chris chooses an ordinary story to tell. Damian asks the question the rest of the family avoided. They tend to get further with an important subject when it arrives in the middle of talk about dinner or work. Asked about *A room for a father*, Damian says, “I am the one who insisted we call him by his first name.”
connections: Franklin Cole. A quiet plant-watering visit gives the diner a reason to ask for better arrival times.

reactions.situation: A tenant refuses to hand back a spare key
reactions.response: Chris asks the tenant what access they would be giving up.

reactions.response: Chris asks which name they want to hear next time and uses it in the next ordinary introduction.
